zh: 对每个左侧元素 a[j]，不论它比 a[i] 大还是小，规则给出的贡献都恰好是 a[i]−a[j]，相等时为 0。
于是 counter[i]=Σ_{j<i}(a[i]−a[j])=i×a[i]−(前 i 个元素之和)，只需维护前缀和即可 O(1) 求出每个位置。
从左到右遍历，维护 prefix 为已经扫过元素之和；对位置 i（从 0 开始）输出 i×a[i]−prefix，然后把 a[i] 加入 prefix；结果可达约 2×10^14，用 64 位整数；按原顺序空格分隔输出。
en: For every earlier element a[j], whether it is larger or smaller than a[i], the rule contributes exactly a[i] - a[j], which is 0 when they are equal.
So counter[i] = Σ over j < i of (a[i] - a[j]) = i * a[i] - (sum of the first i elements), and a running prefix sum gives each position in O(1).

Scan from left to right keeping prefix as the sum of the elements seen so far; for position i (0-based) output i * a[i] - prefix, then add a[i] to prefix. Values can reach about 2 * 10^14, so use 64-bit integers; print the results space-separated in the original order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For any earlier element a[j], its contribution is exactly a[i] - a[j] (0 when equal). Therefore counter[i] = i * a[i] - prefix sum.

## Correctness

If a[j] > a[i], the rule contributes -|a[j] - a[i]| = a[i] - a[j]; if a[j] < a[i], it contributes |a[j] - a[i]| = a[i] - a[j]; when they are equal both are 0. Summing over j = 0..i-1 gives i * a[i] - Σa[j], and a running prefix sum outputs it exactly.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n) (counting the output).
